info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Fitness Memberships Billings-v1-spec
info.description: The Fitness Membership Billings API provides access to billing information related to fitness memberships. Users can retrieve detailed records of billings associated with different membership plans. This API is essential for fitness center administrators and financial teams for monitoring and managing billing cycles. Typical use cases include generating reports, reconciling payments, and addressing customer inquiries regarding their fitness membership charges.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the billing details associated with a membership. It provides necessary information regarding payment status, next billing date, and other relevant financial data.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving membership billing information. This should include all necessary parameters to fetch the billing details associated with the user's memberships.
